messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — lighthouse scan flagged ~12 broken/redirected links under docs/runbooks. attaching summary from the job.
Docs-bot: automated scan result available: /internal/reports/lighthouse-6805550000.json (job id: lighthouse-6805550000)
Maria: thanks. are those false positives (staging assets) or actual 404s?
Alex: initial triage looks mixed. some are staging-cdn assets (likely false positives), a couple are real 404s where a runbook got moved. i ran a quick grep:
Alex: ```rg \"https?://staging-cdn\.internal/\" docs/runbooks -n``` 
Ryan: i can triage the top 6 if someone assigns them. pinging @Jamie for runbooks ownership.
Jamie: i'm covering runbooks this sprint — fine to handoff. alex, can you paste the top 3 that are most urgent?
Alex: sure — top 3 from the report:
 1) runbooks/db-recovery.md -> 404
 2) runbooks/incident-response.md -> 301 -> external/team-handbook (should point to canonical)
 3) runbooks/k8s-scale.md -> returns 403 (staging CDN auth)
Sara: for 301s we should update to canonical links; 403s might be staging-only and safe to ignore if rehosted. 404s need rehost or restore.
Maria: tiny request — when you open fixes, include `Fixes: lighthouse-6805550000` in PR body so the scan ticket links to the change.
Jamie: i'll take the db-recovery rehost and anchor fixes. Ryan can take the CDN/redirect updates. planning PRs by EOD.
Ryan: grabbing the redirect updates now. will include a sed example in the PR for reviewers: `sed -E 's|https?://staging-cdn\.internal/([^\s]+)|/assets/\1|' -i` 
Alex: great — @Docs-bot can you schedule a re-scan after merges?
Docs-bot: re-scan scheduled: 2024-07-05T18:00:00Z (job id: lighthouse-6805550000-recheck)
Jamie: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1423 — rehost + anchor fixes. assigning to @Sara for quick review.
Sara: quick review done, left one nit, merged. :thumbsup:
Docs-bot: re-scan complete — results: 2 warnings remain (external link deprecations). report: https://internal/reports/lighthouse-6805550000-v2.json :white_check_mark:
Alex: perfect, thanks everyone. i'll close the incident in the tracker once the last external deprecation gets scheduled for replacement.
